entities.name: Numena
entities.description: A group of avatar wizards, one per color, who nearly single-handedly overthrew the Primevals of Dominaria.

entities.name: Primevals
entities.description: The rulers of Dominaria overthrown by the Numena.

entities.name: Lowallyn
entities.description: The numen of blue, later reincarnated as Ixidor.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: An illusionist who was Lowallyn reincarnated.

entities.name: Kuberr
entities.description: The numen of black, worshiped as a god of commerce among the Cabal.

entities.name: Averru
entities.description: The numen of red, later reincarnated as an ancient city bearing his name.

events.summary: The numena of white and green were slain by the other three wizards, who refused to share their powers in a five-way split.
events.quote: the numena for the colors white and green were slain by the other three wizards

events.summary: After the numena's reincarnations, they were swiftly destroyed by Karona.
